A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] studied with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its formative in the centuries following the [[Force Wars]] and the abandonment of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and began [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] circa [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]. Stationed at a camp with several other Jedi, the Human sat around a campfire with fellow apprentices [[Cope Shykrill]], a [[Unidentified Fian apprentice|Fian]] and a [[Unidentified Nosaurian apprentice|Nosaurian]]. While listening to a shadow play by Shykrill, the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] apprentice called upon the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to send the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] into a rage and slaughter the Fian and the Human. While Shykrill was injured himself in an attempt to cast suspicion onto the Nosaurian, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Sar Agorn]] and [[Nuck Lyu]] saw through the ruse and killed the dark sider.<ref name="JVS" />
